finding: The propagation applies on the second fixture too - every consecutive pair aligns at IoU 0.70 to 0.97, above the 0.60 refusal floor - but the fitted scale over-states the camera ratio much more badly there. 4 to 5 fits at 1.23, because page 5 adds four pieces to a nine-piece assembly and the fit absorbs that growth. On 40377 the same measure stays between 0.99 and 1.11 because a step adds one to six pieces to a 49-part body. So the over-statement scales with the fraction of the assembly the step adds, which makes the unit-scale hypothesis more load-bearing on a small model, not less, and makes using the fitted ratio alone actively wrong early in a booklet.
